resources.string: Publish a media session without local audio or audio focus. Requires CarPlay audio through vehicle Bluetooth. Applies on the next connection. Bluetooth instrument compatibility needs device testing.
Locks the home, settings and CarPlay screens. Changing this setting reconnects an active CarPlay session after confirmation. Auto restores the original rotation behaviour.
Convert Chinese song titles and artists offline. Android media cards also show pinyin; CarPlay keeps the original text. Pronunciations may be incorrect. Applies on the next connection.
Also convert album names when pinyin is enabled. Applies on the next connection.
Requires the pinyin switch. Match the full original iPhone artist name. Your display name overrides automatic pinyin. Leave it blank to remove a rule. Applies on the next connection.
Enter a valid name: up to 200 characters per name and 100 rules.
